ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
$Setup.OrgConfiguration__c.EnableValidations__c && AND ( LicenseTypeFormula__c <> "R", LicenseTypeFormula__c <> "T",
OR ( LEN( LicenseTypeFormula__c ) = 0, LEN( TEXT(LicenseNumberFormula__c) ) = 0, LEN( TEXT(BranchNumberFormula__c) ) = 0 ),
LicenseType__r.Branch__c <> true
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Except for Temp Licenses and Registrations, License Numbers must have the format License Type - License Number - Branch (Example CT-12345-0)
